MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH p, date_diff('year', strptime(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d'), DATE('2026-10-14')) - CASE WHEN strftime(strptime(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d'), '%m-%d') > strftime(DATE('2026-10-14'), '%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WITH p, age, collect(t.team_name) AS teams
WHERE (age < 42 AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) <= 1) OR ('Detroit Pistons' IN teams AND p.college = 'Temple University')
RETURN p.college AS col1, age AS col2, p.position AS col3, p.name AS name_player
